passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.97

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.101

passages.text: Donaque promissis uberiora feram;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.223
passages.text: Purpura nempe mihi pretiosaque texta dabuntur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.224
passages.text: Congestoque auri pondere dives ero!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.225
passages.text: Da veniam fassae — non sunt tua munera tanti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.226
passages.text: Nescio quo tellus me tenet ista modo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.227
passages.text: Quis mihi, si laedar, Phrygiis succurret in oris?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.228
passages.text: Unde petam fratres, unde parentis opem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.229
passages.text: Omnia Medeae fallax promisit Iason —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.230
passages.text: Pulsa est Aesonia num minus illa domo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.231
passages.text: Non erat Aeetes, ad quem despecta rediret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.232
passages.text: Non Idyia parens Chalciopeve soror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.233
passages.text: Tale nihil timeo — sed nec Medea timebat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.234
passages.text: Fallitur augurio spes bona saepe suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.235
passages.text: Omnibus invenies, quae nunc iactantur in alto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.236
passages.text: Navibus a portu lene fuisse fretum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.237
passages.text: Fax quoque me terret, quam se peperisse cruentam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.238
passages.text: Ante diem partus est tua visa parens;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.239
passages.text: Et vatum timeo monitus, quos igne Pelasgo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.240
passages.text: Ilion arsurum praemonuisse ferunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.241
passages.text: Utque favet Cytherea tibi, quia vicit habetque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.242
passages.text: Parta per arbitrium bina tropaea tuum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.243
passages.text: Sic illas vereor, quae, si tua gloria vera est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.244
passages.text: Iudice te causam non tenuere duae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.245
passages.text: Nec dubito, quin, te si prosequar, arma parentur.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.246
passages.text: Ibit per gladios, ei mihi! noster amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.247
passages.text: An fera Centauris indicere bella coegit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.248
passages.text: Atracis Haemonios Hippodamia viros —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.249
passages.text: Tu fore tam iusta lentum Menelaon in ira

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.250
passages.text: Et geminos fratres Tyndareumque putas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.251
passages.text: Quod bene te iactes et fortia facta loquaris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.252
passages.text: A verbis facies dissidet ista tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.253
passages.text: Apta magis Veneri, quam sunt tua corpora Marti.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.254
passages.text: Bella gerant fortes, tu, Pari, semper ama!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.255
passages.text: Hectora, quem laudas, pro te pugnare iubeto;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.256
passages.text: Militia est operis altera digna tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.257
passages.text: His ego, si saperem pauloque audacior essem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.258
passages.text: Uterer; utetur, siqua puella sapit —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.259
passages.text: Aut ego deposito sapiam fortasse pudore

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.260
passages.text: Et dabo cunctatas tempore victa manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.261
passages.text: Quod petis, ut furtim praesentes ista loquamur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.262
passages.text: Scimus, quid captes conloquiumque voces;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.263
passages.text: Sed nimium properas, et adhuc tua messis in herba est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.264
passages.text: Et mora sit voto forsan amica tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.265
passages.text: Hactenus; arcanum furtivae conscia mentis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.266
passages.text: Littera iam lasso pollice sistat opus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.267
passages.text: Cetera per socias Clymenen Aethramque loquamur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 17.268
passages.text: Quae mihi sunt comites consiliumque duae.
